name: Duong phen
summary: Đường phèn is the rock sugar. The rural-tourism article on vietnamtourism.gov.vn describes white and yellow crystals and a seven-day set. The Cẩm Thành ward article calls it a court tribute. Vietnam Airlines names đường phèn Phổ Hòa and prints no price.
culture: The Cẩm Thành ward article says đường phèn was a court tribute and recalls a workshop at Bằng Lắm in xã An Phú. That workshop is not a shop to visit from the article.
taste: The rural-tourism article says white rock sugar is lightly sweet and cool, and yellow rock sugar keeps the cane-syrup smell and is not bleached. It also prints the local line ngọt như đường cát, mát như đường phèn.
howToEat: The rural-tourism article: white factory sugar cooked with water, egg, peanut oil, and a little lime water, poured into ceramic jars set with thread baskets, then left seven days. The crystals are dried in the sun and broken.
Villages named along the Trà Khúc are Ba La and Vạn Tượng. No hour and no ticket were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Ba La and Vạn Tượng, along the Trà Khúc, in the rural-tourism article. The ward article places the memory of a workshop at Bằng Lắm, xã An Phú.
seoTitle: Duong phen — Quang Ngai rock sugar
seoDescription: White and yellow đường phèn, set for seven days in the rural-tourism article. No price was printed. Check on arrival.
